endpoint_metric: identity exact + valid EOS at the fixed endpoint

next_action.SUCCESS: the contrast's mechanism is supported; record the effect and advance the specific architecture consequence it licenses
next_action.NULL: mechanism not supported; STOP this mechanism line; keep the conservative working choice and move to the next roadmap item (no follow-on experiment is created merely because the answer was null)
next_action.REVERSE_EFFECT: record the reversed effect with the same claim ceiling discipline; it is a full-value result
next_action.PARTIAL_OR_INTERACTION: treat as interaction evidence; do not promote any arm; design the smallest follow-up that separates the interaction
next_action.INCONCLUSIVE: do not reinterpret; restore wall/data budget and rerun the frozen protocol or extend execution partitioning
next_action.ENGINEERING_FAILURE: preserve failure evidence; repair engineering only; scientific protocol unchanged

sealed_policy: per-experiment sealed identity; consumed once after the development protocol is frozen; markers NOT_CONSUMED/STARTED/COMPLETE; STARTED-without-result fails closed
